_about: Jr's own switches. Each flag is turned on by a reviewed PR to this file; the matching repository or runner variable (JR_DEMAND_AUTOMERGE, JR_TICK_AUTOMERGE, JR_CODE_AUTOMERGE, JR_STALL_DISPATCH) set to 0 is the instant kill switch that needs no PR. Both must allow before a canary merges anything or the heal launcher is handed a stall incident (SPEC-jr-self-heal.md §5).
